title: Data-quality rules flag missing required data and invalid references
objective: Verify the rule engine flags assets with missing required fields (per category), invalid references, and inconsistent lifecycle values, classified as errors vs warnings.
preconditions: seed or create: asset missing serial where category requires it; asset with expired assignment inconsistency; complete clean asset.
test_data: data-quality evaluation endpoint or asset data_quality_status field
steps: Verify flagged issues list with rule code, severity (error|warning), asset reference, message.
Verify clean asset has no flags.
expected_result: Issues detected per rules with error/warning classification; asset data_quality_status reflects state; no false positives on clean asset.

title: Possible-duplicate detection feeds work queue
objective: Verify possible duplicates (serial, manufacturer+model) appear in the data-quality work queue with match reasons.
preconditions: two assets sharing serial number; two sharing manufacturer+model only.
steps: Verify both duplicate pairs listed with match reasons and links to both assets.
expected_result: Queue lists duplicates with reasons and asset references; counts accurate; scoped to user's permissions.

title: Resolving an issue preserves audit history
objective: Verify resolving a data-quality issue (fix data or mark reviewed) updates the queue while the resolution and underlying data change are both audited.
preconditions: flagged issue from TC-FR-028-01; operator session.
test_data: fix the underlying data (add missing serial) or resolution action per contract
steps: Fix underlying data via normal PATCH (with version).
Verify issue cleared/marked resolved in queue.
Verify audit events exist for the data fix (and resolution action if distinct).
expected_result: Queue reflects resolution; audit trail complete; issue history not erased.
